text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While thinking over tomorrow's training in 
the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uggghhhhh~! Why is this homework so 
harddd!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Is that really something to cry about?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Ticket. Confront it with logic, 
not emotion.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, got it. Let's tackle this tough 
problem together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading back. I'm already done with 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
NO WAAAY! S-So fast! Am I a whole lap 
behind?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Where are you getting stuck? Let's begin 
by identifying that first.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait! My head is totally scrambled like 
turf on a rainy day!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I don't even know where I'm stuck 
anymoreee!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...This is hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If you calm your confusion and 
focus, it shouldn't be so difficult, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The only time she's not confused is when 
she's running, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! That's it, that's it, Taishin! 
Ticket! Go run outside right this instant!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Run? Yay! ...Wait, is that okay? We're 
in the middle of studying!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. Run a lap around the area at 
full speed. Run with single-minded focus!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Don't blame me if this fails.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A short while later—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm baaaack!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes look... way more sparkly than 
before...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, your state of mind seems fully 
prepared. Now then, please take your seat.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Here is the practice problem. Read 
carefully, think, and try to solve it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
To think that noisy girl could face a 
study guide this quietly...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I-I DID ITTTTT!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, correct. As expected, running 
sharpens your concentration.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Are you going to do that for every single 
question...? Isn't taking tests going to 
be a nightmare?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, we'll address that in due time... 
For now, this works well enough, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*. Hayahide, you're way too soft 
on Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you're saying that, wouldn't the same 
apply to you... complaining while still 
staying right here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wha...! I-It's not like I...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you both! I found my way to 
concentrate!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! Help me out with the rest of my 
homework too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Move your hands instead of your mouth. 
Come on, open the study book.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...You always give it your absolute all 
and inspire us in the process.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yet, the one drawing the most strength 
from all of us is also you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You truly are an intriguing one, 
Ticket.
